title: MiniGrid hidden-task persistent organization and structural recovery

protocol.feedback: terminal success/failure only, after each episode
protocol.capability_library: fixed MiniGrid expert policies used only to isolate organization
protocol.held_out_transfer: new environment seeds in transfer phase; first episode per family is zero-shot
protocol.interference: four mixed family blocks before transfer and revisit
protocol.damage: half of persistent slots are reset before post_damage
limitations: capability policies are privileged and frozen
partial observation signature is a coarse engineered encoder
oracle is an upper bound, not a learnable competitor
